purpose: Ordered multiview texture authority for the fourteen non-Kestrel/non-Palisade Arc Relay retextures, with a restrained owner-directed value lift

materialPolicy.sourceDirection: muted powder-coated metal and technical ceramic with satin roughness, oxidized hardware, restrained wear, and no toy gloss, neon, pastel, or near-black dominant hulls
materialPolicy.transformEffect: The deterministic value lift changes RGB tone only; it adds no saturation, synthetic highlight, reflection, or gloss cue.

transform.rationale: Lift shadows and midtones above approved Palisade while preserving near-white highlights and reducing contrast rather than increasing saturation.

valueAuditMethod: 384x256 RGB sample; retain pixels with luminance below 205 or HSV saturation above 0.14; compare median Rec.709 luminance
